pip_requirements.description: The default file pattern matches neither requirements/*.in nor our <distro>-<flavor>-<arch>.txt lockfiles, so without this Python deps are never updated. Only the direct pins in the .in files are bumped; lockfiles are regenerated by lock.yml and scripts/check-lock-consistency.sh fails CI until that happens.

customManagers.description: image:tag@sha256:digest pins in workflow env values / matrix strings / run scripts and the pre-commit docker_image hook (invisible to the built-in managers)

packageRules.description: Never silently re-point an action SHA within the same tag

Automerge base image digest bumps as a PR after cooldown. This relies on required status checks once branch protection is enabled (not yet in place). CI tool images (hadolint, actionlint, gitleaks, uv, osv-scanner, python) and the dockerfile frontend stay manual: a digest update on a version tag is a tag re-point of something that runs with CI privilege.
Python bumps never automerge: the lockfiles must be regenerated (gh workflow run lock.yml) before CI goes green
Base images appear in images/*/Dockerfile AND the lock.yml matrix; bump them in one PR so the resolver and the build never disagree
